description: GoHighLevel (HighLevel) is an all-in-one sales/marketing CRM platform (agency-focused) with a public REST API (v2, branded LeadConnector).
access_notes: Public API docs and OAuth app registration are openly available via the Marketplace developer portal; a GoHighLevel/sub-account is needed to test against, but no separate approval gate found for API access itself.
api_notes: Contacts, opportunities, calendars, conversations, payments, and marketplace-app object model -- a wide surface reflecting the all-in-one product.
